bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated qualitatively as the primary motivation for the study. The authors assess the linguistic and cultural biases present in existing Arabic LLMs—which rely heavily on translated English data—and address it by constructing a massive, culturally authentic monolingual Arabic dataset from scratch.

Measured quantitatively by analyzing the geographic distribution of country-specific top-level domain names (e.g., .sa, .ae) among the filtered URLs in the dataset. This analysis identifies regional imbalances, specifically an overrepresentation of Saudi Arabian domains and a noticeable scarcity of content from North African Arab countries.
